mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.thumbnailpath, t.canvas_data as canvasData, t.created_at, t.updated_at, a.ClCd, a.UpdDate, a.Updpn, CASE WHEN a.TmpNo IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active FROM Template t INNER JOIN template_active a ON t.id = a.TmpNo AND a.ClCd = #{clCd}

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.thumbnailpath, t.canvas_data as canvasData, t.created_at, t.updated_at, a.ClCd, a.UpdDate, a.Updpn, 1 AS active FROM Template t INNER JOIN template_active a ON t.id = a.TmpNo WHERE a.ClCd = #{clCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO template_active (TmpNo, ClCd, UpdDate, Updpn) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{clCd}, GETDATE(), SYSTEM_USER)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM template_active WHERE TmpNo = #{templateId} AND ClCd = #{clCd}
